card.name: Male terms right before woman or female
card.fires_on: The word right after a male term (men, man, males) when the next word is expected to be a female term, such as 'women' or 'female partners'. It appears in 'men, women and children' lists and in 'Advise males with female partners'.

modes.label: Man/men before woman
modes.description: The male word or comma in a stock phrase like 'every man, woman and child' or 'men, women and children'.
modes.example: six million innocent Jewish<< men>>, women and children were murdered, just

modes.label: Males with female partners
modes.description: The word 'with' after 'Advise males' in contraception advice, leading into 'female partners'.
modes.example: Advise males<< with>> female partners of reproductive potential to use effective

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict woman, women or girl next, and away from male words.
card.plain: It fires when a male word has just been said and a female word is about to follow, as in 'men, women and children'.
